name: sandcastle-kit
description: Shared Sandcastle setup: one base image, one orchestrator, per-project config.

scripts.test: export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=commit.gpgsign GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false && case "${TEST_SHARD:-1/1}" in 1/*) bash test/status.test.sh ;; esac && tsx --test ${TEST_SHARD:+--test-shard=$TEST_SHARD} --test-timeout=300000 test/*.test.ts
